title: Pacific Equity Partners and Merrill Lynch - proposed acquisition of Veda Advantage
acquirers: Pacific Equity Partners and Merrill Lynch

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: A consortium comprising Pacific Equity Partners and Merrill Lynch proposes to acquire Veda Advantage Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered Pacific Equity Partners' and Merrill Lynch's proposed acquisition of Veda Advantage Ltd in the context of the following relevant markets: - A national market for the provision of business marketing services; - A national market for the provision of business credit services; and - A national market for the provision of consumer credit services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to cause a substantial lessening of competition given that it would result in a bare transfer of market share between Veda Advantage Ltd and the consortium comprising Pacific Equity Partners and Merrill Lynch in the relevant markets.
